value.rationale: Shampoo is defined by accumulated matrix second moments and inverse fourth roots, while later work interprets a no-accumulation idealization as polar descent. The exact stationary-gradient law bridges those two views and quantifies, at every iteration, how fast the actual source accumulator erases singular-value anisotropy. The target-condition-number time and damping-controlled slowest-mode error are natural diagnostics for the role of the regularizer rather than arbitrary numerical slices.
